dict.string: Do This Now turns your reminders into tasks it can pick from and plan your day around, and ticks them off when you finish them.
The camera scans the barcode or QR code that turns your wake-up alarm off. Nothing is recorded or saved.
Do This Now rings your wake-up alarm at the time that fits your morning, even in silent mode.
When you tap “We’re off schedule” on a trip, Do This Now uses where you are to work out travel times to what’s next. It isn’t saved or sent anywhere.
